title: Why college degrees are becoming worthless in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 60% of college grads can't find jobs in their field?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI and automation are changing the job market faster than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: A college degree no longer guarantees a good job or higher pay.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Companies are prioritizing skills over degrees, like coding or digital marketing.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Millions of recent grads are stuck in low-paying jobs or unemployed.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real value now is in hands-on experience and tech skills.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one skill you can learn today that could beat a degree?
